title: Storage usage
description: Largest folders and files, media and recent downloads in shared storage

actions.label: Largest folders
actions.command: du -sk /sdcard/* 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -n 12 | awk '{s=$1; u="K"; if(s>=1048576){s=s/1048576;u="G"} else if(s>=1024){s=s/1024;u="M"} n=$2; sub(/^\/sdcard\//,"",n); printf "%7.1f %s  %s\n", s, u, n}'

actions.label: Photos, videos, music
actions.command: du -sk /sdcard/DCIM /sdcard/Pictures /sdcard/Movies /sdcard/Music /sdcard/Download 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | awk '{s=$1; u="K"; if(s>=1048576){s=s/1048576;u="G"} else if(s>=1024){s=s/1024;u="M"} n=$2; sub(/^\/sdcard\//,"",n); printf "%7.1f %s  %s\n", s, u, n}'

actions.label: Files over 50 MB
actions.command: find /sdcard/ -type f -size +50M -exec du -k {} + 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -n 15 | awk '{s=$1/1024; $1=""; sub(/^ \/sdcard\//,""); printf "%7.0f MB  %s\n", s, $0}'
